release_notes: Right-justify the timestamp on every Ready Messages log line so they form a clean vertical column on the right edge of the log regardless of how wide the body text in front of them is. Previously 'Plain old line', 'Room 1: Ready' (12pt bold), and 'Room 2: Ready' (15pt bold) each rendered at a different width and the trailing '[hh:mm AP]' floated to a different x on each row; with the new layout all timestamps end at the same column. Implementation: every line uses a tab character between body and timestamp, and the Text widget is configured with a right-aligned tab stop a few pixels in from its right edge. A <Configure> binding repositions the tab stop on every window resize so the column tracks the visible log area. The on-disk persistence file canonical form is now 'body\t[ts]'; a one-shot _migrate_old_log_line helper rewrites any pre-1.0.62 ('[ts] body') or 1.0.62 ('body  [ts]', double-space) entries on the fly during _load_ready_log so an upgraded user immediately sees the aligned column on the next launch without waiting for midnight rollover.
